# Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium

Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium is a Danish child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinic located in [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] [^src1] [^src2] [^src14]. It appears repeatedly across two consecutive annual reports of the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-databasen]] — the national Danish quality-monitoring database for ADHD assessment and treatment — covering the reporting periods 01.04.2023–31.03.2024 and 01.04.2024–31.03.2025 [^src9]. The clinic reports its results directly to the ADHD-databasen [^src9].

The department's standout achievement, and its central claim to significance, is being the only department nationally to meet the 90% standard for completing somatic assessment within 120 days of the start of an assessment process, achieving exactly 90% compliance across 286 assessment cases in the 2023/24 report [^src1] [^src14]. This is reported in slightly different framings across the source material: one passage states the department met "indikatoropfyldelse af 90 % af de i alt 286 udredningsforløb" [^src1], while another specifies 257 out of 286 cases completed somatic assessment (90%, 95% CI: 86-93) [^src14].

Beyond somatic assessment, the clinic shows a markedly uneven performance profile across the ADHD-databasen's other quality indicators. On indicator "Ja 2a" (clinical environmental observation, relevant to children aged 0-5), Aabenraa achieved 100% compliance across 15 cases in 2023/24 [^src1], and this pattern of full achievement recurred in 2024/25, where Aabenraa and [[vejle-boerne-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Vejle Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] both reached 100% on indicator 2a for a third consecutive year (2022/23, 2023/24, and 2024/25) [^src6]. The department was also named, alongside the ambulatories in Aabenraa, Odense, Vejle, and [[bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-smaaboern|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn]] in Midtjylland, as meeting the standard for this indicator in the 2023/24 report [^src15].

However, the picture is far less favorable on other measures. In the 2023/24 report, the clinic recorded only 5% compliance on Indicator 3 (diagnostic conferences) across its 286 assessment cases [^src2], and only 10% compliance (95% CI: 7-14) on Indicator 4 (coordinating network meetings), with 30 out of 293 cases meeting the standard [^src3]. Data for a further indicator (page 33, 2023/24 report) shows a figure of "1 (0-2)" against an unclear denominator [^src4]. In the 2024/25 report, this weak performance on diagnostic-conference-type measures persisted: Aabenraa posted just 9% (26 out of 278 cases) on one indicator [^src7], 5% (14 out of 278) on another [^src8], and was explicitly singled out as the department with the lowest indicator fulfillment nationally — 5% — among departments handling more than three cases, contrasted with [[bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-smaaboern|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn]] at 81% [^src8]. On another measure the same year, the clinic reached 83% (232 out of 278 cases) [^src9], and on indicator 2b it achieved 93% (271 out of 292 cases) [^src6] [^src17], with the 89% figure (240/271) reported for the prior year [^src15].

The department's results also feature prominently in discussions of extreme highs and lows: in one instance it is cited as one of several departments achieving 100% compliance on a particular indicator, alongside PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Syd Ambulatorier i Nordjylland and PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt i Midtjylland (later reported as 3 out of 3 cases, 100%, 95% CI: 29-100) [^src11] [^src12] — while on another indicator that same year it recorded 0 out of 3 cases (0%, 95% CI: 0-71) [^src10]. Indicator 1 achievement was reported at 91% for 2024/25 [^src16] [^src17], and indicator 2b at 93% [^src16] [^src17]. A further figure of 47% (144 out of 308 cases) appears for another indicator that year [^src17], and a raw figure of "58" appears without further indicator context [^src12], alongside earlier figures of "57 81 36" [^src5].

Taken together, these results depict a department with strong performance on somatic assessment and environmental-observation indicators, but persistently weak performance — often the weakest nationally — on indicators related to diagnostic conferences and coordinating network meetings, consistent with the broader ADHD-databasen narrative of Danish child and adolescent psychiatric departments facing capacity pressures, staffing shortages, and rising referral volumes [^src8].

## Claims

**Performance metrics**
- Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium opfylder standarden med indikatoropfyldelse af 90 % af de i alt 286 udredningsforløb [^src1]
- Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium opfylder standarden for klinisk miljøobservation med 100 % compliance blandt 15 forløb [^src1]
- PSY Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Vejle) og PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa) begge nåede udviklingsmålet med 100 % opfyldelse af indikator 2a, hvilket også var tilfældet både i 2023/24 og 2022/23 [^src1] [^src6]
- PSY Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa) opnåede 93 % opfyldelse af indikator 2b [^src1] [^src6]
- Børne- og Ungdomsambulatorierne i Aabenraa har 89 % andel på indikator 2b (240 / 271) [^src1] [^src15]
- PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa) nåede 91 % [^src16]
- PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa) opnåede 93 % på Indikator 2b[^src1] [^src17]

**Performance (indicator-specific)**
- Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium opnåede 5 % opfyldelse af Indikator 3 blandt 286 udredningsforløb [^src3] [^src2]
- Blandt afdelinger med mere end tre forløb spænder målopfyldelsen fra 5 % (PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa) til 81 % (BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn) [^src1] [^src8]

**Facility performance**
- Aabenraa havde 10 % opfyldelse af indikator 4 (95% CI: 7-14) med 30 forløb ud af 293 [^src1] [^src3]
- Blandt afdelinger med mere end tre patienter fra 21 % på PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik i Hovedstaden til 100 % på PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Syd Ambulatorier i Nordjylland, PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt i Midtjylland og PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa) [^src1] [^src11]

**Clinical outcome**
- Aabenraa Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium opfylder standarden for somatisk udredning med 90% (95% CI: 86-93) [^src1] [^src14]
